title: Dominic and the Orbit
author: Elodie Thackeray
blurb: Vesper Villalobos, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
